title: Chemical Drain Cleaners Are a Safe Quick Fix
description: Many homeowners believe pourable chemical drain cleaners are a safe, universal fix for clogged drains. In reality, caustic chemicals generate intense exothermic reactions that can deform thin PVC piping, degrade rubber gaskets, and corrode older metal lines. Additionally, trapped chemical solutions pose severe chemical burn hazards for plumbers who must service the drain mechanically when the chemical fails. Chemical cleaners also frequently fail on deep main line clogs or solid obstructions. Mechanical clearing methods, such as a hand auger or drain snake, safely remove blockages without compromising pipe integrity or personal safety.

Chemical cleaners also frequently fail on deep main line clogs or solid obstructions. Mechanical clearing methods, such as a hand auger or drain snake, safely remove blockages without compromising pipe integrity or personal safety.
